title: Pure Power Tool
summary: Leo's Power Tool archetype revolves around equipping multiple Equip Spells to Power Tool Dragon (Level 7), Power Tool Mecha Dragon (Level 7), Power Tool Braver Dragon (Level 9), and evolving into the Signer Dragon Life Stream Dragon (Level 8)! Use Morphtronic Scannen, Telefon, and Celfon to Synchro Summon Level 7 Power Tool Dragon (revealing 3 Equip Spells from your Deck to add 1 to your hand) and Level 9 Power Tool Braver Dragon! When Power Tool Braver Dragon is Special Summoned, it equips up to 3 different Equip Spells directly from your Deck and/or GY—giving it 4000+ ATK, targeting protection for your whole board via Metalsilver Armor, and a Quick Effect during the Main Phase to send 1 Equip Spell to negate a monster's effects or change its battle position!

allow.Mage Power: Classic Equip Spell equipped from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon or searched by Power Tool Dragon that grants +500 ATK/DEF for every Spell/Trap you control.
allow.Metalsilver Armor: Equip Spell equipped directly from the Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon: while equipped, your opponent CANNOT target any monster on the field, or in either GY, with card effects, except the equipped Power Tool Braver Dragon!
allow.United We Stand: Equip Spell searched by Power Tool Dragon or equipped by Power Tool Braver Dragon that grants +800 ATK/DEF for each monster you control.
allow.Living Fossil: Equip Spell searched by Power Tool Dragon that revives a Level 4 or lower Morphtronic from your GY to extend into Power Tool Braver Dragon!
allow.One for One: Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Level 1 Morphtronic Telefon or Celfon directly from your Deck.

main: Morphtronic Scannen

Level 6 EARTH Machine Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand by banishing 1 Morphtronic from your hand, searches any 'Morphtronic' card in Attack Position, and recovers a Morphtronic from GY in Defense Position!
Morphtronic Telefon
Core Level 1 EARTH Machine Tuner: in Attack Position, rolls a die to gain LP and Special Summons 1 'Morphtronic' monster from your GY with a Level less than or equal to the roll!
Morphtronic Celfon
Level 1 EARTH Machine: rolls a die in Attack Position to excavate that many cards from the top of your Deck and Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Morphtronic monster among them!
Morphtronic Smartfon
Level 1 EARTH Machine Tuner: banishes 1 Morphtronic from GY to Special Summon itself from hand, and rolls a die to excavate and add any 'Morphtronic' card from Deck to hand!
Morphtronic Remoten
Level 3 EARTH Machine Tuner: banishes 1 Morphtronic from GY in Attack Position to add 1 Morphtronic with the same Level from Deck to hand.
Morphtronic Boomboxen
Level 4 EARTH Machine (attacks twice in Attack Position) that pairs with Level 3 Remoten for Level 7 Power Tool Dragon, or with Level 7 Power Tool + Level 1 Tuner + Level 1 for Level 9 Braver Dragon!
Morphtronic Staplen
Level 4 EARTH Machine that switches an opponent's monster's battle position when attacked (triggering Life Extreme!) and provides a Level 4 non-Tuner.
Gadget Box
Continuous Spell: places 3 Morph Counters on itself on activation, and removes 1 Morph Counter once per turn to Special Summon a Level 1 EARTH Machine Token.
Morphtronic Converter
Targets 1 Machine monster you control to add 1 'Morphtronic' monster with a different name from your Deck to your hand, and places 1 card from hand on top of Deck.
Morphtronic Repair Unit
Equip Spell: discards 1 Morphtronic monster to Special Summon 1 Morphtronic monster from your GY and equips to it.
Life Extreme

Signature Equip Spell for Power Tool Braver Dragon: gives +1500 ATK to an EARTH Synchro; destroys 1 card on field when a monster's battle position changes; and re-equips itself when sent to GY by Braver Dragon!
Double Tool C&D
Signature Equip Spell for Power Tool Dragon: gives +1000 ATK during your turn and negates the effects of any monster it battles, and forces your opponent to attack Power Tool Dragon!
Metalsilver Armor
Equipped directly from your Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon to prevent your opponent from targeting any other monster on the field or in either GY with card effects!
Mage Power
Equipped from your Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon or searched by Power Tool Dragon for up to +2500 ATK/DEF.
United We Stand
Equipped from your Deck by Power Tool Braver Dragon or searched by Power Tool Dragon for +800 ATK/DEF per monster you control.
Living Fossil
Searched by Power Tool Dragon to revive a Morphtronic and climb into Power Tool Braver Dragon.
Power Break
Signature Trap that sends up to 3 Equip Cards equipped to Power Tool Dragon to destroy an equal number of cards on the field and burn for 500 each.
One for One
Limited to 1 in TCG: Special Summons Morphtronic Telefon or Celfon from your Deck.
extra: Signature Level 9 EARTH Machine Synchro boss: when Special Summoned, equips up to 3 Equip Spells directly from Deck/GY; Quick Effect during Main Phase to send 1 of its Equips to GY to negate or change battle position!
Signature Level 7 EARTH Machine Synchro boss: once per turn reveals 3 Equip Spells from Deck for opponent to add 1 to hand; sends an Equip to GY to prevent its own destruction!
Level 7 DARK Machine Synchro: draws 1 card when an Equip Spell is equipped to this card; Quick Effect to steal a face-up Equip Spell on the field!
Signature Level 8 EARTH Dragon Synchro Tuner: sets LP to 4000 when Synchro Summoned, makes all effect damage 0, and banishes 1 Equip from GY to protect Synchro Monsters from destruction!
